special1.name: Regeneration
special1.description: Restore 6% maximum HP (14 at Level 1), capped at missing HP. Replaces the basic attack; retains the normal Duality resource roll without basic critical effects.

special2.name: Starlight
special2.description: Deal 22% Attack as direct damage (42 at Level 1).

special3.name: Falling Star
special3.description: Guaranteed Finisher: 30% Attack on timeout; picks 1–5 deal 35–55%. Choose within four seconds.
